_doc: HAUSSMANN P0.5 (editorial gate, O2) — dated allowlist of REVIEWED, PERMANENT exceptions to the leak lint. This is NOT the debt list: today's genuine leaks live in leak_baseline.json and must go to zero at P1.3. An entry here says 'this token, on this surface, is deliberate public copy'.
_discipline: Every entry carries surface + pattern + an explicit `tokens` list + rationale + date + reviewed_by. Token-scoped by design: allowlisting `learn/** internal_id` wholesale would let a NEW internal id (e.g. campaign_haussmann) leak into a tutorial unseen. Only the reviewed strings are excused; anything else on the same surface still goes red.
_surface_globs: `**` matches any path suffix. `index.html` matches the built homepage exactly.

entries.rationale: The homepage 'aDNA in action' demo panel deliberately renders a real mission file to show what a vault artifact looks like. gate-16's own header records this as intentional body copy ('D1 surfaces real artifacts in body copy … deliberately'). Showing the artifact IS the demonstration.
